A 398 kg roller coaster cart starts from rest at the top of a frictionless track at height h = 8.01 m above ground level. Using the principle of conservation of mechanical energy, calculate the speed of the cart at the bottom of the track.
explanation: E_mech(top) = E_mech(bottom) => m*g*h = 0.5*m*v^2 => v = sqrt(2 * g * h) = sqrt(2 * 9.8 * 8.01) = 12.53 m/s.
